facts: The Endpoints table names all nine existing project type operations, including enable, import, mark-default and the per-type schema route; none is a new operation.
The project-mode lifecycle explicitly orders enable, type create, project property create, attach and schema read, then work item creation using type_id and custom_fields.

The governance_mode attribute links its separate governance update operation, and the mode warning links workspace type listing as the other surface; the remaining attributes explain the type response resource.
Reads work in either mode; project writes normally require project mode, import requires workspace mode, and mark-default and is_active-only updates are exceptions.
